name: Pan’s Arcadia
review:
Pan's Arcadia is a 3x6, 13-line mythology slot. Golden Nektar triggers respins, a 2x multiplicative wild stirs things up, and the bonus game climbs through six levels.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 4,320x cap and a 96.10% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
